integrity: Uniform symbolic proof supplied. Nine independent finite exhaustive graph-construction tests support the exact formulas but are not an infinite proof. An unindexed equivalent result is a remaining originality risk. No independent mathematical validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All three factors must be finite connected one-dimensional simplicial complexes with at least one edge. No classification is asserted for higher-dimensional factors, disconnected factors, or higher tuplings. The graph-join witnesses have the homotopy type of spheres, not necessarily manifold triangulations.
title: Homotopy of three-tuplings of triple graph joins and an equal-face-vector separation
